title: Nine lives are taken off for his father’s one.
html_source:
Conglomerate allusions in the following sentences. This sentence is inaccurate as eight lives are lost after Hamlet Snr is killed. Gifford
http://www.amazon.co.uk/Ulysses-Annotated-Notes-James-Joyces/dp/0520253973 suggests a hint of ‘cats have nine lives’ or a reference to the passing of Shakepeare’s son Hamnet.
